sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 4. After the above order was passed, the present writ petition has been filed to declare that the acquisition proceedings has lapsed.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 5. In the considered view of this Court, the earlier grievance that was expressed by the petitioners is that they were not paid the compensation and that they were deprived of the same.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: That apart, the petitioners, who are also seeking for re-conveyance of the land that was acquired.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Having taken such a stand on an earlier occasion, the petitioners cannot now seek for a declaration to declare that the acquisition proceedings have lapsed.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The prayer for re-conveyance and the declaration to declare the acquisition as lapsed under Section 24(2) of the 2013 Act, cannot go together.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The fact that the petitioners are seeking for re- conveyance only means that they are not in possession of the property.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 6 March, 2025.json

Therefore, the Apex Court is repeatedly holding that where the land has vested under Section 16 of 1894 Act, if the original owner continues to be in https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis (

6.

sentences.text: In view of the above, the relief as sought for in the present writ petition cannot be granted by this Court.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: If the compensation amount has not been paid to the petitioners, it is always left open to the petitioners to independently seek for the said relief before the appropriate forum.

sentences.text: This is in view of the fact that the land which is acquired must result in the payment of compensation to the land owner which has been held to be a fundamental right by the Apex Court in various decisions.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 6 March, 2025.json

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
That apart, the petitioners, who are also seeking for re-conveyance of the land that was acquired.
Having taken such a stand on an earlier occasion, the petitioners cannot now seek for a declaration to declare that the acquisition proceedings have lapsed.
The prayer for re-conveyance and the declaration to declare the acquisition as lapsed under Section 24(2) of the 2013 Act, cannot go together.
The fact that the petitioners are seeking for re- conveyance only means that they are not in possession of the property.
